The price (per litre) of petrol increases by 85%. By what percent should its consumption be reduced so that the expenditure on it increases by 11% only?

Assume original price = ₹100 and consumption = 100 litres. Original expenditure = ₹10000. New price = ₹185. Allowed expenditure = ₹11100 (11% increase). Required consumption = 11100/185 = 60 litres. Reduction = 100 − 60 = 40%.
Gopal invests ₹5400 and Akshay invests ₹10200 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 4 years, Akshay gets ₹720 more interest than Gopal, find the rate of interest per annum.
Difference in principal = 10200 − 5400 = 4800. SI difference = PRT/100. So 720 = (4800 × R × 4)/100. Therefore R = 3.75%.

Difference for 3 years = P×r²(300+r)/100³. Here r = 10. So Difference = 0.031P. Hence 0.031P = 93 ⇒ P = 3000.

A person travels by a motorcycle to a place at an average speed of 60 km/h and returns at an average speed of 30 km/h. Find his average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey.

The cost of painting a spherical vessel of radius 7 cm is ₹18480. What is the cost of painting per square centimetre? (Use π = 22/7)
Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × 22/7 × 7² = 616 cm². Cost per cm² = 18480/616 = ₹30.

Let Raj receive x. Then Varun receives (1612−x). Equal amounts after investment: x(1.08)^14=(1612−x)(1.08)^15 ⇒ x=(1612−x)×1.08. Solving gives x≈837.

Ram, Ravi and Reena can do a piece of work in 16, 20 and 24 days, respectively. They began the work together but Ravi left the work 5 days before the completion of the work. In how much time did they finish the work together?
Let total time=x days. Ram and Reena work for x days, Ravi works for (x−5) days. Equation: x/16+(x−5)/20+x/24=1. LCM=240. 15x+12(x−5)+10x=240 ⇒ 37x=300 ⇒ x=300/37=8 4/37 days.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements. Statements: No almond is a date. No date is a raisin. No date is a cherry. Conclusions: I. No almond is a raisin. II. Some cherries are raisins.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows
Both Conclusions I and II follow
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows

From the statements we only know that dates are separate from almonds, raisins and cherries. There is no direct relationship between almonds and raisins or between cherries and raisins. Hence neither conclusion logically follows.

The bitwise XOR operator ^ compares corresponding bits. 10 = 1010, 6 = 0110. 1010 ^ 0110 = 1100 = 12.
The bitwise NOT operator ~ inverts all bits. For 5 (0101), ~5 gives 1010 in two's complement, which is -6.
